title: Divergence: engine::replay_present_proof certifies L3 from a non-standard-axiom interactive proof (proof-backends REQ-4/§1, R-DEFER-9)

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Failing test at forge/tests/divergence_axiom_smuggling.rs::divergence_interactive_replay_accepts_nonstandard_axiom demonstrates the divergence. AUTHORITY: proof-backends.md REQ-4 (L3-via-Lean base = {Lean kernel + 3 standard axioms, EXP}), thermite-design.md §1 (enumerable trusted base), REQ-7(ii) z3-demotion bar (#print axioms = standard set only), R-DEFER-9 (no proof cheats). TOOLCHAIN: engine::replay_present_proof (forge/src/engine.rs) gates a replayed proof only on (1) the evidence-key header match + (2) engine::proof_has_sorry; proof_has_sorry/axioms_contain_sorry scans ONLY for 'sorry'/'sorryAx', NOT a trust-base axiom allowlist. INPUT: a tier-(c) recursive item f whose checked-in .lean-proofs/f.lean keeps the fresh evidence-key header but proves 'theorem thermite_obligation_f : True := thermite_cheat _' with 'axiom thermite_cheat : ∀ (p:Prop), p'. EXPECTED: f rejected/skipped (the base would be a lie). ACTUAL: f certifies L3 with engine_attribution.trust_profile = {Lean kernel, propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound, EXP, author} — omitting thermite_cheat. Live-verified (lake+verus present). The replay also does not bind the proven theorem STATEMENT to the obligation (the cheat proves ': True', not the ens), a related hole in the same gate.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Commit the failing pin test forge/tests/divergence_axiom_smuggling.rs (un-ignored — soundness release-blocker; the failing test IS the block). No production code touched (critic role). Generator must add a trust-base axiom allowlist gate in engine::replay_present_proof: a replayed proof's #print axioms must be ⊆ the declared standard set, else Unknown/reject — and bind the proven theorem statement to the obligation.
